target: scaffold.sh keep/stamp — a deliberately kept local edit is never reclassified as replaceable, and the keep list survives a re-stamp
cmd: source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/scaffold.sh"; source "$FIXTURES/scaffold-fixture.sh"; export SCAFFOLD_STAMP_PATH=scripts/.agentic-scaffold.json; scaffold_fake_plugin fake 0.9.0; scaffold_put fake/scripts/lib/tracker.sh UPSTREAM; scaffold_put scripts/lib/tracker.sh MY_LOCAL_EDIT; scaffold_write_stamp fake software-interviewed src1; S1=$(scaffold_status fake software-interviewed | awk -F'\t' '$1=="scripts/lib/tracker.sh"{print $2}'); scaffold_keep '  scripts/lib/tracker.sh  '; S2=$(scaffold_status fake software-interviewed | awk -F'\t' '$1=="scripts/lib/tracker.sh"{print $2}'); scaffold_write_stamp fake software-interviewed src2; S3=$(scaffold_status fake software-interviewed | awk -F'\t' '$1=="scripts/lib/tracker.sh"{print $2}'); jq -n --arg s1 "$S1" --arg s2 "$S2" --arg s3 "$S3" --arg keep "$(jq -c '.keep' "$SCAFFOLD_STAMP_PATH")" --arg body "$(cat scripts/lib/tracker.sh)" --arg valid "$(jq -e . "$SCAFFOLD_STAMP_PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo yes || echo no)" '{s1: $s1, s2: $s2, s3: $s3, keep: $keep, body: $body, valid: $valid}'
